title: Rare I.M. Pei mansion in Texas hits market for $22 million
summary_full: A unique Fort Worth estate designed by architect I.M. Pei is now listed for sale at $22 million. This is the first time the property has been available since its construction in 1969. Known as Westover House, it is one of only three private residences created by Pei. The home features spacious living areas, multiple bedrooms and modern amenities across nearly four acres.
